summary.text: Father of Iasus (`iasus-athenian`), captain of the Athenians slain by Aeneas — attested by Homer as son of Bucolus when the battle turned grim about the hollow ships.

story.text: When Apollo roused the Trojans and Hector pressed the Argives back, Aeneas slew Iasus, a captain of the Athenians who was called the son of Sphelus, son of Bucolus.
